target_applications: research (mobile manipulation, HRI, embodied AI), industry, agrifood, healthcare, logistics, retail, education

dof_total.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago-pro/ (incl. default grippers: 2x7 arms + 1 torso + 2 head + 4 base + grippers)

reach_mm.source: https://pal-robotics.com/datasheet/tiago-pro/ (vertical reach 92 cm; horizontal dual-arm span 236 cm; SEA arm extended reach 96 cm)

torso_lift.value: 350 mm prismatic lifting torso (1 DoF, joint brake)

battery_kwh.source: n/a (not disclosed; optional additional battery + dock charging station)

actuators.value: series-elastic actuators (SEA) in arms, joint-level torque sensing on every arm actuator, 6x joint brakes per arm, 1 kHz EtherCAT bus; impedance control + gravity compensation

end_effector.value: 2x PAL parallel grippers (default), quick tool changer, ISO 9409-1 flange; optional Allegro Hand 16 DoF with 4x Xela fingertip tactile sensors; optional 6-axis wrist F/T sensors

media_at_flange.value: quick tool changer, ISO 9409-1 mounting flange; expansion panel on torso: 2x USB 3, 1x HDMI, 2x Ethernet, 36V/5A + 12V/8A power

sensors_head.value: RGB-D camera, 4-mic array, 2x 4W speakers, 10-inch face touchscreen, RGB LEDs, expressive eyes; ROS4HRI person perception (skeleton, gaze, face ID)

sensors_wrist_hand.value: joint torque sensors in all arm joints; optional 6-axis wrist F/T sensor; optional Xela tactile fingertips (Allegro Hand)

sensors_base.value: 2x LiDAR laser range finders, 10 m, 360 deg combined FoV (25 m upgrade)

compute.value: Intel i5, 16 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD (upgrade: i7, 32 GB, 1 TB; optional NVIDIA Jetson PC); Wi-Fi 6, BT 5.2, WireGuard VPN

software_stack.value: Ubuntu LTS + PREEMPT-RT, ROS 2, ros2_control, MoveIt 2, Nav2, PAL Web GUI, Docker PAL SDK, MuJoCo/Gazebo sim, ROS4HRI, offline ASR 20+ languages, TTS + chatbot engine

safety_compliance.value: e-stop, joint brakes (arms + torso), energy-absorbing SEA arms, torque-based collision awareness; no public CE/ISO 13482/TS 15066 certification statement (n/a, not disclosed)

price.value: not disclosed (quote-based); ~USD 85-95k reported in market chatter, unverified

availability.value: shipping worldwide, direct quote-based sale; lead time not disclosed

deployment_evidence.value: CO-HAND EU project: TRL 7 validation in textile manufacturing (2026); ROSALYA food-industry project; euROBIN research network; no public unit counts

notes: Announced as 'TIAGo Pro Edition' ~May/June 2023 (third-party article Jun 1, 2023), contradicting some reports of a late-2024 launch; current edition marketed 2024-2026. height_mm is max (torso raised); min 1200 mm. Single-arm and no-arm configurations available. 7 m3 total workspace (vendor).
